race.comment: Tough race to end the day. ERNAUX (13) scored a long overdue win as fav when slicing through the field and clearing out for a slick win over this track and trip. Meets stiffer opposition here but looks to have more to offer from the low draw. COLUMBIA BLUE (1) slow into stride and got going late when a narrow third to EXIT FEE over 1200m here with the 60kg. Winning rider hops back aboard and can make amends today. CALL ME GORGEOUS (7) slashing return over the unsuitable trip when he produced slick closing splits to run fourth over 1000m here in BM88 class. Has a good second up record and can go on with it this campaign. EXIT FEE (8) finally put it all together when defeating his stablemate by a nose over 1200m here on the good surface. Jumps in weight and place best. HIDRIX (11) talented three-year-old resuming. Maps well and wasn't pushed out in the two trials. Keep safe.
